description: The dark-theme image filter: Chrome applies the CSS filter invert(93%) hue-rotate(180deg) to SVG images in dark mode; the raster backend applies upstream's numeric version of it (applyDarkModeFilter), so the tolerance is the distance between the two
toleranceNote: Every draw goes through ports of Chrome's own pipeline (Skia's analytic anti-aliasing, edge builder and clipper, stroker, dasher and AntiFillRect, Blink's arc handling), so what remains is rounding in blending, coverage and sampling: against Chrome 153 no pixel here is more than 2 levels off. 8 leaves room for another Chrome build that rounds differently. The dark filter is upstream's numeric applyDarkModeFilter against Chrome's CSS invert(93%) hue-rotate(180deg); they agree within 2 levels.
